summary: Completed the initial schema-version-2 review of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A common stock after the 2026-07-30 lower-Bollinger and volume-anomaly transitions. Q2 revenue grew 28%, Family daily active people reached 3.60 billion, ad impressions grew 14%, and average price per ad grew 12%, while quarterly costs rose 55%, capital expenditures reached USD 31.08 billion, and free cash flow fell to USD 784 million amid legal charges, severance, AI investment, and continuing Reality Labs losses. The alert was a post-results fundamental repricing and timing risk rather than a stand-alone opportunity: the July 31 rebound removed the lower-band breach but did not resolve cash-conversion risk. At the USD 556.71 mark, bounded USD 400/600/800 bear/base/bull values produce USD 580 probability-weighted value, 4.18% expected return, and 3.14% confidence-adjusted expected return. Deterministic state derives Hold/Watch, complete research, quality score 86, and ineligible allocation because expected-return, base-upside, downside-payoff, and relationship gates fail. No strategy or idea follow-up was created.
